blocks.text: Propositional logic computer science mein istemal hone wali logic ki ek bunyadi qism hai. Is mein aise statements (jumle) aate hain jo ya sach (true) hon ya jhoot (false). Aise statements ko propositions kehte hain (Figure 2.3 dekhein).

blocks.alt: Chaar statements, har aik teer se apni truth value tak: 2 + 3 = 5 True (sach), The sky is blue True, 1 > 3 False (jhoot), Today is Sunday False.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.3: Propositional logic ke statements (kitab ki Figure 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har statement ki sirf ek truth value hai: ya True ya False. 2 + 3 = 5 sach hai, 1 > 3 jhoot hai. “Today is Sunday” ki value din par depend karti hai: Itwar ko sach, baaqi dinon jhoot; kitab ne isay False dikhaya hai. Phir bhi har din yeh ya sach hai ya jhoot, is liye yeh proposition hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Propositional logic logic ki sab se aasan qism hai, lekin computer ki saari reasoning ki bunyad yahi hai!
